propositions: Data Center backend has no parametrized value-pinning characterization suite equivalent to Cloud's test_backend_characterization.py; only test_backend_contract.py exists and asserts shape not values, leaving DC's values unpinned despite recent authorship and high risk

The shared OutboundFieldMapper.map_fields_to_remote is exercised only through AdfCodec in existing tests, never through WikiTextCodec, creating a blind spot where DC-specific composition regressions could reach production undetected

Data Center's _backend() fixture uses FakeTransport which unconditionally stubs probe_remote to UNREACHABLE, making it impossible to pin probe branches through the normal seam; the real classification must be pinned via jira_family.classify_probe_response or a real JiraDataCenterTransport

DC's DEFAULT_RESOLVED_STATUSES is byte-identical to Cloud's RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES, making any probe pin at defaults vacuous and unobservable; a non-default custom set must be used to prove DC binds its own resolved statuses not Cloud's

Every newly added value pin must be mutation-checked by perturbing the pinned value and confirming test failure, with each mutation and verdict recorded twice: as a ticket comment and as a module-level comment block in the test file for committed evidence
